# Unreleased Mantle packages

These tarballs were built from the unreleased Mantle developer-console branch
so this project exercises the real package exports without depending on
unpublished registry state. Runtime, spec, and web packages are pinned at
`620252551b012295a6bb882de4274213e66fe4dd`; the Admin packages are pinned at
`c00b7e9b7399c6c3ff478c35aa7d0653a53e7a2e`. The umbrella package, including
its embedded docs, is pinned at `c00b7e9b7399c6c3ff478c35aa7d0653a53e7a2e`.
